title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named Pasadena destinations on distinct nearby corridors, each with a source-backed reason to stop.

cards.title: Pasadena Playhouse
cards.subtitle: S. El Molino Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the current performance calendar, then use the box office at the historic theater on South El Molino Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A historic theater stop on the El Molino corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Pasadena Playhouse is located at 39 S. El Molino Avenue and includes a 643-seat historic theater.
cards.access_notes: Performances and ticket availability vary; consult the Playhouse calendar or box office before visiting.

cards.title: Playhouse Village Park
cards.subtitle: E. Union Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the paths and open grass area for a daytime pause; the city lists restrooms and a drinking fountain on site.
cards.short_summary: A city park with paths, open space, and practical amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Playhouse Village Park at 701 E. Union Street has open grass, paths, a playground, dog areas, restrooms, and drinking fountains.
cards.access_notes: City-listed park hours are daily, 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: USC Pacific Asia Museum
cards.subtitle: N. Los Robles Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit around the Wednesday–Sunday schedule, or choose a second Sunday when the museum lists free admission.
cards.short_summary: Asian and Pacific arts museum on North Los Robles.
cards.evidence_claim: USC Pacific Asia Museum is at 46 N. Los Robles Avenue, is open Wednesday–Sunday, and lists free admission every second Sunday.
cards.source_title: Visit Us — USC Pacific Asia Museum
cards.access_notes: Regular admission applies except listed free-admission periods; hours are Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Pasadena Convention Center
cards.subtitle: E. Green Street corridor
cards.notes: Look up the public event calendar before heading to the campus; the official directions identify the Civic Auditorium at this address.
cards.short_summary: A Green Street event campus anchored by the Civic Auditorium.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pasadena Convention Center is at 300 E. Green Street, and official directions place Pasadena Civic Auditorium at that address.
cards.source_title: Parking & Directions to the Pasadena Convention Center
cards.access_notes: Entry and cost depend on the specific scheduled event.

cards.title: Norton Simon Museum
cards.subtitle: W. Colorado Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Set aside time for the galleries and sculpture garden; students with ID and visitors 18 and under are listed for free admission.
cards.short_summary: An art-museum stop at Colorado and Orange Grove.
cards.evidence_claim: Norton Simon Museum is at 411 W. Colorado Boulevard; admission is free for students with ID and everyone age 18 and under.
cards.source_title: Norton Simon Museum — Plan Your Visit
cards.access_notes: The museum lists hours Sunday, Monday, Thursday 12–5 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 12–7 p.m.; it is closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

cards.title: The Gamble House
cards.subtitle: Westmoreland Place corridor
cards.notes: Walk by the house and gardens, then reserve ahead if you want the guided interior tour rather than an exterior visit.
cards.short_summary: A preserved house museum on Westmoreland Place.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gamble House is at 4 Westmoreland Place; visitors may explore its exterior and gardens, while house visits are by tour.
cards.access_notes: Tours run Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday; advance ticketing is recommended.

cards.title: Kidspace Children's Museum
cards.subtitle: N. Arroyo Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Bring younger relatives for the outdoor campus and check the daily exhibit availability before purchasing admission.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on children’s museum on North Arroyo Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Kidspace Children’s Museum is at 480 N. Arroyo Boulevard and describes its site as a 3.5-acre outdoor campus.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; paid admission is generally required.

cards.title: Rose Bowl Stadium
cards.subtitle: Rose Bowl Drive corridor
cards.notes: Check the stadium’s tour or event schedule before making the trip to the landmark venue on Rose Bowl Drive.
cards.short_summary: A National Historic Landmark stadium destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Rose Bowl Stadium is at 1001 Rose Bowl Drive and is recognized as a National Historic Landmark.
cards.access_notes: Tour and event access depend on the current schedule and ticketing.

cards.title: Arlington Garden
cards.subtitle: Arlington Drive corridor
cards.notes: Take the marked paths through the public garden in daylight, and leave flowers, fruit, and planted areas undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A free public garden for a quiet daylight walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Arlington Garden is a three-acre public garden, open seven days a week during daylight hours and free to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open during daylight hours and closed after dark; follow the garden’s posted etiquette and stay on marked paths.

cards.title: Pasadena City College Colorado Campus
cards.subtitle: E. Colorado Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the public campus map to locate a scheduled arts, athletics, or community event before heading east on Colorado Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed college campus with public event venues.
cards.evidence_claim: Pasadena City College's Colorado Campus is at 1570 E. Colorado Boulevard and lists public event venues including its theater, auditorium, observatory, and gallery.
cards.access_notes: Campus facilities and event access vary; consult the college’s current calendar and campus map.
